slots.title: Tom Lee sees $2 trillion wealth transfer fueling crypto demand as Bitmine buys more ether
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The Bitmine chairman said he expects younger investors to drive demand for digital assets as his ether treasury company inches closer to owning 5% of the total supply.

slots.title: Tokenized catastrophe bonds target the disaster-insurance gap
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: A planned Bermuda issuance would put legal ownership onchain and seek capital for disaster risks that remain costly to insure.

slots.title: Palantir's Europe head warns the region is 'missing the boat' on AI just as it did with the internet
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The Palantir UK chief said the U.S. is racing ahead on enterprise AI while Europe hesitates, and explained why he thinks the company faces intense political attacks.

slots.title: Meta releases its first frontier model, Muse Wonder
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Where Muse Spark aimed to be a lightweight model that could perform at low latency, the Wonder models are larger and said to be more capable, with higher benchmark scores and better results on complex tasks like coding.

slots.title: FTX’s crypto mining venture is now used to advance AI
slots.author: Cointelegraph
slots.summary: The defunct exchange acquired a 20% stake in Genesis Digital Assets before FTX declared bankruptcy in November 2022.
slots.reason: A major development affecting both AI and blockchain

slots.title: WindBorne wins a hefty US Air Force contract for its balloon data
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: A Silicon Valley startup that uses weather balloons and AI to predict the weather won a U.S. military contract worth almost $50 million.
slots.reason: Outside your usual reads — worth a skim
